name: Charles S. Eaton
role: Manager of the SOHO ranch; one of the Eaton brothers
bio: Charles S. (Charlie) Eaton ran the SOHO ranch and in January 1885 put his losses on newly arrived cattle at under 2 percent. He shipped SOHO cattle to Jamestown in January 1885 and took VI and SOHO cattle to Chicago in October 1885, and that July he reported grasshoppers damaging the southern Yellowstone ranges. After the Chicago trip he spent the fall in Pittsburgh, his old home, returning in December 1885. In May 1886 he came back from his wedding trip with his bride and her mother.
